features.description: New mod menu enhancements to display all animals and pets in the avatar/pet creator. Some are server validated.

features.title: Screenshot Hotkey (F9)
features.description: Press F9 to prepare for screenshot. Hides UI/GUI and zooms out. Use zoom controls in mod menu with Shift +/- to fine tune.

features.title: Clothing Layer Order
features.description: New popup added to the mod menu to reorder which clothing items display on top.

features.title: Hide Player/Nametag for Screenshots
features.description: New mod menu enhancements to hide your player avatar and nametag for cleaner screenshots.

improvements.title: Massive UI Overhaul
improvements.description: Comprehensive visual refresh and quality of life improvements across the entire application.

improvements.title: Right-Click Context Menus
improvements.description: Context menus added in the network tab and plugins tab with new options to explore.

improvements.title: Mod Menu Improvements
improvements.description: Click issues addressed. Multi-clothing toggle now unequips items when disabled.

improvements.title: Headless + Performance Mode Refined
improvements.description: Refinements to both Headless mode and Performance mode mods for better stability.

improvements.title: App Zoom Controls
improvements.description: Zoom within the main app now using Ctrl and +/-.

improvements.title: TFD Automation Default Whitelist
improvements.description: Default whitelist added for TFD Automation plugin.

improvements.title: Multiple Plugins Revamped
improvements.description: Several plugins overhauled including Tiki Trouble Automation with dynamic userId, retry logic, stats, and sound notifications.

fixes.title: Anti-AFK Fixed
fixes.description: Anti-AFK system now works correctly.

fixes.title: Flash Memory Leak Fixes
fixes.description: Fixed several Flash memory leaks to improve stability during longer sessions.

fixes.title: All New Pets Display Correctly
fixes.description: All new pets now render and display properly.

fixes.title: Pet Egg Crash + Prediction Fixed
fixes.description: Resolved crash when hatching pet eggs and fixed egg prediction.

fixes.title: Animal/Pet List Crash Prevention
fixes.description: New mod menu enhancement to prevent crashing when loading large pet and animal lists.

fixes.title: Pairs Plugin Fixed
fixes.description: Pairs plugin fixed to work with Strawberry Jam.

shortcuts.title: F9 - Prepare for Screenshot
shortcuts.description: Hides UI/GUI and zooms out for a clean screenshot. Enable zoom hotkeys in mod menu to fine tune with Shift +/-.

shortcuts.title: Ctrl +/- - App Zoom
shortcuts.description: Zoom the main application window in and out.
